A CLEAR STARTING POINT

Your first consultation.

What to ask, what to prepare and how to take the first step with Kostyantyn Mykhalchenko.

Request an appointmentCall (289) 888-5878
Before bookingWhat to prepareNext steps
01 / CONFIRM FIRST

Before you book

Use your first contact to establish the practical arrangements. Fees, meeting length and availability should be confirmed directly with the practice.

Availability
Ask whether the practice can assist with your type of matter and the dates involved.
Format & location
Confirm whether the meeting will be in person or remote, and any address or joining instructions.
Duration
Ask how much time is available and which questions should be covered first.
Consultation fees
Ask whether the initial consultation is paid, what it includes, and how any applicable fees and taxes are handled.
Scope & next steps
Clarify what can be discussed at the consultation and what would require a separate engagement.
02 / AGREE ON THE NEXT STEP

Leave with the right questions answered

Before proceeding, ask which tasks the lawyer can take on, what you will need to do, and how the proposed fees will work. Confirm whether the practice has accepted the matter and how further communication will take place.

An enquiry or appointment request does not confirm representation or change a deadline. If a date is approaching, flag it when you contact the practice.

A few practical questions

Is sending an enquiry the same as booking?

No. The form sends an enquiry. Wait for the practice to confirm availability and appointment arrangements.

Should I upload documents?

The enquiry form does not accept uploads. Start with the general topic and ask the practice how to share documents securely.

Can the consultation be in French?

Appointments are offered in English, Ukrainian and Russian. The French website provides information and does not indicate French-language representation.
